title: 2007 AMC 10A 6
statement: At Euclid High School, the number of students taking the AMC \(10\) was \(60\) in \(2002,\) \(66\) in \(2003,\) \(70\) in \(2004,\) \(76\) in \(2005,\) \(78\) in \(2006,\) and is \(85\) in \(2007.\) Between what two consecutive years was there the largest percentage increase?

solutions.text:
From \(2002\) to \(2003,\) the increase is \[ \dfrac{6}{60} = \dfrac{1}{10} = 10\%. \]

The other increases are \(\dfrac{4}{66},\) \(\dfrac{6}{70},\) \(\dfrac{2}{76},\) and \(\dfrac{7}{78},\) each less than \(\dfrac{1}{10}.\)

So the largest percentage increase was between \(2002\) and \(2003.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Percentage increase equals the increase divided by the earlier value
